## Services

1. **Mobile Phone Repair** — iPhone, Samsung, Google Pixel, all brands. Screen, battery, charging port, water damage, camera, speaker.
2. **Tablet & iPad Repair** — iPad Pro/Air/mini, Samsung Galaxy Tab. Screen, battery, charging port.
3. **Laptop Repair** — HP, Dell, Lenovo, ASUS, Acer. Screen, keyboard, SSD upgrades, OS fixes, liquid damage.
4. **MacBook Repair** — MacBook Air/Pro M1/M2/M3. Screen, logic board, battery, liquid damage, keyboard/trackpad.
5. **Computer Repair** — Desktops & all-in-ones. Diagnostics, virus removal, hardware upgrades, Windows reinstall.
6. **Custom Computer Builds** — Gaming PCs, workstations, budget PCs, ITX builds. Designed, assembled, stress-tested.
7. **Game Console Repair** — PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch. HDMI port, overheating, drive faults.
8. **Apple Watch Repairs** — Series, SE, Ultra. Screen, battery, charging, water damage.

## Additional Services

- **Doorstep Collection Service** — Free pickup & return across East Kilbride, Busby, Eaglesham, Cambuslang, Rutherglen, Carmunnock, Giffnock
- **Data Recovery** — Hard drives, SSDs, USB drives, SD cards, phone storage
- **Ticket Tracking** — Track repair status online by ticket ID
